title: Where Is My Bat?
summary: A boy has lost his bat and searches for it in every corner of the house. Where could it be?
pages:
Oh, oh, oh! I've lost my bat!
My long, yellow, favorite one — it vanished, just like that.
Where is it? Where?

I looked behind the door —
"Not there!"

I looked on the shelf, from the top to the floor —
"Not there!"

I looked under the bed, in the dust and the socks —
"Not there!"

I climbed inside the big box, all the way to the end —
"Not there!"

I went up to the attic, to the very last beam —
"Not there! Not there! Not there!"

I looked here, I looked there, I looked all over the world.
Then I heard someone laughing... at the window.

And there she was, the girl next door, with my bat in her hand!
"I took it... I almost asked. Sorry!"
"Next time, ask," I said, "and let's play —"
And now? It was there! There, there, there — at the window!
